tools.name: get_docs
tools.description: Fetch Ptally documentation by topic. Call BEFORE building or editing a config to load the rules and reference material you need. Topics: "rules" = agent rules, constraints, expression syntax, quality gates, and debugging guidance (start here); "readme" = full engine reference with step types, query

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Fetch the full JSON schema for Ptally project config files. Use to check exact field requirements, allowed step types, and property constraints.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Server-side schema validation of a project config. Returns { valid: true/false, errors: [...] } with the JSON path, keyword, and message for each issue. Prefer local validation against get_schema during authoring; use this as a ground-truth check, including on an amended model before handing it back

tools.name: get_starter
tools.description: Fetch a worked-example Ptally project for a common line of business. Each example is a small, fully valid project with realistic collection tables, calculations, exclusions and refers, plus an embedded tests[] suite for reference. Use as a template — copy and adapt rather than authoring from scratch

tools.name: get_projects

findings.detail: Description of "get_quote" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: validate_project, get_quotes, get_quote, run_quote · Private data: get_schema, validate_project, get_projects, get_project, run_version_tests · Public sink: get_quote, run_quote, patch_version · Destructive: get_project, run_quote, run_version_tests, patch_version.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: validate_project, get_quotes, get_quote, run_quote · Private data: get_schema, validate_project, get_projects, get_project, run_version_tests · Public sink: get_quote, run_quote, patch_version · Destructive: get_project, run_quote, run_version_tests, patch_version

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "run_quote" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
